svg.title: PinVoyager — Liquid Glass icon proposal
svg.desc: Recommended teal icon, dark and clear appearance studies, original vector comparison, and small-size previews.

g.text: The same Horizon Pin. A new material.
Original vector geometry, frosted glass, deep teal, and a quiet sense of depth.
Preserved: pin outline, mountain strokes, sun, proportions, and negative space.
Static material studies. Final lighting, refraction, and appearance rendering belong in Apple Icon Composer.
